title: I showed AI a dog with 5 legs 🐕

beats.say: I showed AI a picture of a dog with five legs.
One simple question. How many legs does it have?
Then a famous three stripe shoe logo, with a fourth stripe added. It said three.
In a 2025 study, top AI models counted the extra legs right only about two percent of the time.
On normal pictures they scored a hundred percent. On edited ones, seventeen.
Why? It isn't really counting. It knows dogs have four legs, so that's what it sees.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
